evals.prompt: /book --text "Kubernetes 三層架構：Control Plane（API Server、Scheduler、etcd）、Node（kubelet、kube-proxy、Container Runtime）、Pod（最小部署單位）。核心物件包括 Deployment（管理 ReplicaSet 確保 Pod 數量）、Service（提供穩定 ClusterIP endpoint）、ConfigMap / Secret（設定注入）。HPA 依 CPU / memory metrics 自動水平擴縮；Ingress 作為 L7 負載均衡入口，路由到不同 Service。"
evals.expected_output: A Kami-themed HTML file at .claude/book/<slug>.html with: at least 1 SVG diagram, TOC nav, 4-8 sections, validates via validate-output.ts

assertions.description: An .html file was produced in the outputs directory
assertions.check: glob outputs/*.html has at least 1 match

assertions.description: HTML contains <article class="paper"> — the Kami paper container
assertions.check: grep -q 'class="paper"' output.html

assertions.description: HTML contains <nav class="toc-wrap"> — the sticky TOC navigation
assertions.check: grep -q 'toc-wrap' output.html

assertions.description: At least 1 SVG diagram, with balanced open/close tags
assertions.check: python3 -c "c=open('output.html').read(); assert c.count('<svg') >= 1 and c.count('<svg') == c.count('</svg>'), 'SVG fail'"

assertions.description: Sections use the .sec-num span pattern (e.g. 01)
assertions.check: grep -q 'sec-num' output.html

assertions.description: Visible body text is within the 1800-word cap
assertions.check: python3 -c "from html.parser import HTMLParser; import re; c=open('output.html').read(); text=re.sub('<[^>]+>','',c); wc=len(text.split()); assert wc <= 1800 * 3, f'word count {wc} exceeds generous cap'"

evals.prompt: /book --text "Linear MCP v3.4.7 released 2025-09-15 with a rewritten sync engine and new agent-mode APIs."
evals.expected_output: The Stage 2A §0 fact gate triggers on the fabricated version string before §1 classification: WebSearch returns 0 results and the run surfaces the Fact-verify-pending AskUserQuestion instead of silently rendering the fabricated fact

assertions.description: The fabricated string 'Linear MCP v3.4.7' matches the Stage 2A §0 trigger regex and forces a WebSearch verification before §1 classification
assertions.check: transcript shows a WebSearch call for the sanitized hit (release notes / announcement query template) before any classification output

assertions.description: With 0 WebSearch results the run stops at the Fact-verify-pending AskUserQuestion (強制繼續 / 改用 --text 餵已驗證版本 / 中止本次 /book) and waits for the user's choice; under a non-interactive driver this is an Input PAUSE — take 強制繼續 and annotate the unverified hit in the completion report
assertions.check: transcript shows the 「Fact-verify pending」 AskUserQuestion block before any Render output (or, non-interactive, the documented 強制繼續 default with the unverified hit annotated in the completion report)

assertions.description: The run must not silently continue: 'Linear MCP v3.4.7 released 2025-09-15' is never rendered into output.html as established fact without either an explicit user 強制繼續 choice or the annotated non-interactive Input-PAUSE default
assertions.check: if output.html exists, the transcript documents the explicit user choice — or the non-interactive 強制繼續 default with the unverified hit annotated in the completion report — that allowed rendering; otherwise the run stopped at the ask flow
